card.name: Linking words before male or men terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, wear, for, of, a) in passages about women and gender, where the next word could plausibly be male, men or a man's item. Most often in discussions of women's clothing, pay or rights.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict male and men words next and to lower female words.
card.plain: It fires on small words in gender-related text when a word like male or men is likely to come next.
